prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production game animation sprite sheet, ONE original medieval shield knight B-KN from Ember Expedition.
Reference image role: style reference ONLY for chunky pixel clusters, cream-gold armor, muted teal cloth, short 2.5-head proportions. Do not reproduce the reference sheet layout or other characters.
Create ONE transparent sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024, EXACTLY 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 256x256 tiles with NO drawn grid or text. All 22 visible frames depict the SAME knight, equipment and proportions consistent. Fixed camera and sprite scale; all frames face RIGHT. Full body and weapon inside each cell, generous transparent margins, feet anchored at y=214 within each cell, character about165 pixels tall. Crisp discrete pixel clusters, no smooth gradients, no ground, no shadows outside sprite, genuine alpha background.
Character: compact original knight, round teal and brass shield on left forearm, short steel sword in right hand, cream segmented armor, broad flat noseplate helmet with narrow horizontal dark visor and asymmetric small teal crest. Geometric ember-shaped shield boss, no cross or recognizable franchise emblem.
Exact animation layout read left-to-right:
Row1 columns1-4: four subtle breathing IDLE poses, feet fixed, shield rises slightly then settles.
Row1 columns5-6: two HIT reactions, torso recoils backward then recovers, feet planted.
Row2 all six columns: six WALK cycle frames toward right, alternating leg and arm poses, continuous loop, shield travels with arm, no horizontal position drift.
Row3 all six columns: six ATTACK frames: ready low sword, pull sword behind shoulder, begin forward swing, sword fully forward at impact, follow-through downward, recover. Strong clearly DIFFERENT weapon angles and torso poses. Sword must visibly swing, not just body bobbing.
Row4 columns1-4: four DEATH frames: stagger, buckle knees, collapse, lie still with weapon. Row4 columns5-6 completely empty transparent.
No letters, captions, watermarks, guides, duplicate standing characters replacing action frames. This is 22 consecutive motion drawings, not a character selection chart. Maintain exact uniform tile grid.

Style reference image ONLY: retain short 2.5-head proportions, chunky crisp pixel clusters, cream/gold/teal medieval palette, strong dark contour; design this specified character independently, no trademark emblems.
ONE landscape1536x1024 sheet, precisely6 equal columns by4 equal rows, each256x256 cell, NO text/grid/lines/labels.
Same character, same costume and size across ALL22 motion frames. Each sprite is only160pixels tall including gear with wide transparent margins, placed near CENTER of tile; feet precisely at y=212 within its tile. All facing RIGHT. Neither body nor attack effect may cross a tile boundary. Genuine transparent alpha outside character. No background, ground or shadow.
Row1 columns1-4:4 distinct subtle breathing idle frames, feet stationary. Row1 cols5-6:2 hit recoil/recovery frames.
Row2 all6 columns:6-frame WALK loop, visibly alternating legs and arms, consistent anchor position, not6 repeated standing poses.
Row3 all6 columns:6-frame ATTACK motion detailed below; clearly changing hand/weapon angles, correct timing.
Row4 cols1-4:4 DEATH frames: stumble, knees buckle, collapse, lie motionless on ground baseline. Last2 tiles completely transparent.
Clean game-ready readable pixels, limited shaded colors, no smooth illustration or motion blur. No UI, caption, watermark or scenic background.
Unit ID E-IC-F, Freeze Arcanist.
Appearance: visible human face framed by short silver braid, slate-blue long coat with ice-gray reinforced shoulders, long icy staff with wide crystal foot, firm planted stance.
Row3 attack frames in order: lift staff, pull it back, point crystal toward floor, strike ground releasing small cyan frost fan RIGHT, hold staff planted, recover.
Keep same exact face, weapon, clothing, silhouette in every frame. User wants original characters, no references to existing franchises.
